services.name: Honors Acting Conservatory
services.desc: Each year, ten students committed to personal growth embark on a year of study and exploration into the craft of acting for theatre. From January through December, students perform in private scene study classes, receive one-on-one mentorships, and participate in workshops and performance opportunities tailored for their particular needs-all through The Theatre Lab’s Honors Acting Conservatory. Admissions for the Honors Acting Conservatory’s Class of 2027 are now open. Applications are due October 15, 2026. Auditions will be scheduled in October and November.
